cases.name: two suites name one guard and one file, which is two names for one thing
caught_by: check_mutations_roster: two suites name the same guard *and* the same file. One of them is invisible to this check, and which is an accident of file order. Two suites for one guard are fine when they mutate different files; two for one file are two names for one thing.
